QF.id: AIFM CII Legal Documents and Negotiations_12

question.text: Under the SEBI (AIF) Regulations, how must the Investment Manager or Sponsor of a (non-LVF) AIF launch a new scheme with respect to the PPM?

answer.text: File the PPM directly with SEBI at least 7 days prior to launch, without any intermediary.
File the PPM with AMFI and obtain a no-objection certificate before launch.
File the PPM with the custodian who then forwards it to SEBI within 45 days.
File the PPM with SEBI through a SEBI registered Merchant Banker at least 30 days prior to launch of the scheme, along with payment of scheme fee.

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook (pages 78 and 187-188) requires the Investment Manager/Sponsor to file the PPM with SEBI THROUGH A SEBI-REGISTERED MERCHANT BANKER, at least 30 days prior to launch of the scheme, along with payment of the scheme fee. LVFs are the only exception — they file directly under an 'intimation' model with a CEO/Compliance Officer undertaking. The Trap: Direct-to-SEBI filing applies only to LVFs. AMFI has no role in AIF PPM filing (AMFI is for mutual funds). Custodians are back-office service providers, not regulatory filing channels. Note: Keep to the workbook rule — merchant-banker channel, 30-day prior filing, scheme fee, with the LVF carve-out.
